steps.content: The screams are tearing at your nerves. The contamination is ripping your consciousness apart. Countless hands of filth are sticking onto your body.
Something is fusing into your body and dissolving your consciousness.
Frantic words are buzzing in your ears, ringing louder and louder.
It feels so familiar and nice... As if it's always belonged in your body.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Accept...

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: The gift...
The arms of filth are tightening, as if wanting to drag you into the abyss.
You struggle hard to break free from its constraints, but in vain.
Just as you're about to be devoured by this chaos...
You find yourself lying on the bed in the lounge.
You scramble up, your shirt already soaked in cold sweat.
Since that day, you often go back to that place in your dreams. The horrifying Corpseborne and the unknown Gift keep reappearing in your dreams.
There seems to be a fearsome link between you and the Black Ring. You need more information, you need to know what has happened to you.
Having collected yourself, you call the Ring Research Institute through the distant communication system.
Hello, this is Chief of the MBCC.
It only takes a few seconds for the man to pick up.
You want to request help, but you are not sure where to start.
After all, you've seen too many strange things these past few days.
You don't need to explain. I know you have a lot of questions about yourself.
We'll provide you with a new videotape.
You know the drill. Go meet Summer. She'll give you the answers to everything.
You hang up. Like some kind of clairvoyant, the Ring Research Institute gives you the solution before you even ask.
How has he come to know what's been happening to you? Can it be that you're being spied on by the Ring Research Institute?
You try your best to calm your agitated nerves. The situation is already messed up enough for your limited attention to get distracted.
There's no doubt the Research Institute is on the DisCity's side. They will certainly help the MBCC. Without the previous videotape, you never would have gotten anything from Summer.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I want to apologize for what happened.
Nightingale is holding another encrypted videotape in her hand.

options: Send it straight to the Sinner Summer's room.

choices.text: Send it straight to the Sinner Summer's room.

steps.content: It'll be needed right away.
Nightingale nods and strides off.
Even geniuses face setbacks. Tens of thousands of them, no less.
The disaster is storming near, but the hero has not finished her preparation.
She's been kicked out of the institute and stripped of her rights as a hero, yet she continues her research in harsh conditions.
Her research is coveted by many and used for malicious purposes by invisible enemies. Summer can only fight alone.
But Summer refuses to yield.
Because she's the superhero who'll save the world. She is invincibility itself!
She breaks through the bottleneck and invents a powerful and unbeatable weapon!
She aims right at the enemies' nest and eliminates them once and for all...
All obstacles can be overcome, because she is the invincible protagonist! The hope that saves the world!
To be continued...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Rate it. What do you think of the script and storyboard this time?

options: Were you serious when you made this?

choices.text: Were you serious when you made this?

steps.content: What? You said I did a pretty good job last time!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: How come the rating has flopped so hard this time around?!
If you think about it, it's not an easy thing to make every frame ridiculous either.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Well, state the ridiculous parts then!
I'll give you a few examples.

options: Why has Summer gotten kicked out of the institute?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It'll only slow down the pace for the audience, so I only mentioned it briefly and transitioned straight to the important scenes after that!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Huh? You didn't even get that? Because Summer finds the institute boring, obviously!
Is this really coming from a hero who's saving the world?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Why not? Why must the world-saving hero always listen to everything the institute says?!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Like, in the Evarvlav, the protagonist barely listens to the institute either! Hasn't he saved the world too, in the end?!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Argh! I don't care, I don't care. Stop nagging, Chief!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Before you work on the battle scenes, why don't you consider the overall quality first?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Don't worry—of course I'm considering it! I even have the best ending already in place!
Despite Summer's catastrophic scriptwriting, you're still curious about what kind of surprise she can bring you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ugh... I'm not telling you!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It's still inside this genius brain of mine!
Letta
Just like magic, all your stress disappears temporarily when you're bickering with Summer.
Today especially, Summer seems even happier than before, having gotten the second episode.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Since we started talking, haven't you been feeling a little more relaxed?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I noticed you were a little distracted when you were watching the anime.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Haha... You're not very good at hiding your anxiety.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: So I guess... you're bothered by some kind of tough question.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A question as tough as the one about the Mania Crystal last time.
Touché. After all, geniuses are indeed way more observant than ordinary people.
Ever since absorbing the fragment, the Bureau has been secretly examining your body with devices every day, to check for any abnormalities.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I suppose you're scared as well, scared of having to investigate something you don't know or understand every day.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: In anime, whenever a protagonist encounters something like this, they get really sad. You're actually quite tough.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Relax, Chief. I swear on my reputation, Summer the Genius Scriptwriter, I'll cheer you up with anime!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Come on, what do you want to know this time? I can answer any questions.
You're hesitant, deliberating whether you should recount your experience to Summer before you.
If you keep it to yourself, no one will know you've touched a fragment of the Black Ring. But this fragment is like a ticking time bomb buried deep inside your body.
Yet in the whole DisCity, besides Summer, there's no one else you can talk to and can hopefully get you out of the plight you're in.
You decide to first ask Summer to help tackle the problem that's been troubling you for the longest time.

options: Tell me about the Black Ring.

choices.text: Tell me about the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Haha... Just as I expected. I knew you'd ask me this.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I know you've just been inside one not long ago. How was it? The view inside the Black Ring must be very—exciting, no?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Although I've never physically entered a Black Ring, I've been inside a simulated version of it thousands of times already. I've seen all the possible situations basically!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: There are always that kind of extremely weird landscapes inside... And some certain space-time distortion phenomena as well.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Many Corruptors are even controlled by certain wills and will attack the enemies of their controllers.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: And you're connected to the Sinner Zoya through the shackles. You must have seen some extraordinary things.
Summer's words take you back to ground zero in Keylan Square.
Amid the blazing flames, the distorted space is spreading uncontrollably.
The hatred-filled flesh and blood, the jealous, vicious evil eye, and the muddy land...
It's powerful, pure, intense, and fearless. Yet also utterly filthy.
Pain and passion intertwine in your body, growling. The shackles released from your hand split into countless blood-red thorns.
All of its remains rush into your body like a hurricane, wrecking and piercing through your soul.
Something enters your body—you don't feel sick or strange at all.
It comes, then it goes.
That fragment lies within your body right now.
Your previously suppressed emotions pours out suddenly. You cover your mouth and desperately hold back the urge to vomit.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Chief, Chief... What's wrong? Do you have low blood pressure? Here, have some chocolate!
Seeing you in this condition, Summer seems worried.
You really never entered a Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Of course, I haven't. I'm not venturing into a Black Ring before I'm perfectly prepared for it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: By the way... You should avoid using those rickety Hyperpyramids.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The inside of a Black Ring is a spiritual realm. If you stay there for too long, your mind... may get completely corrupted.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's right, that's a place where the mind can affect reality.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: A ground zero's will is going to gradually corrupt and distort everything in reality.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I call that place an imaginary number sequence of will.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Sounds pretty cool, doesn't it?
You glare at Summer.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Ahem, I digress... In that place, everything you see is real.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But... They're unreal too. Everything has long fallen out of the norm.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Their spirits have long become united with the sequence of will, so they've turned into puppets who know nothing other than following orders.

options: What about the black, silt-like stuff in there?

choices.text: What about the black, silt-like stuff in there?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's the substance released by the Black Ring—the Ring substance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But it's not exactly accurate to call it a substance. It's a by-product created when the imaginary number sequence of will invades reality.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It contains extremely powerful mental power and can even influence substances in reality.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Humph, for sure. This is also the idea behind the Ring Weapon's design, using the purest spirits as its core to provide bottomless firepower!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Sigh... It's a shame that before the Ring Weapon was put into mass production, the project got called off. Otherwise, with this weapon, the FAC could have long eliminated all traces of whatever Mania super easily.
It looks like the fragment inside you hides even more secrets you're unaware of.
You must eradicate its influence. Otherwise, it may awaken anytime and corrupt your mind completely.

options: How do you stop mental contamination?

choices.text: How do you stop mental contamination?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Spiritual contamination is only a phenomenon, an outcome.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Essentially, it is the result of mutual interference and compression of the boundaries of the spiritual and physical dimensions.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: To stop it completely, you need to eradicate the source of Mania—the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Except that someone already tried that long ago.

options: Was it during the BR-000 incident?

choices.text: Was it during the BR-000 incident?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No, even earlier than that.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: When the Perishing Star struck, someone already came up with this solution.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: But until today, no one has succeeded.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Though existing Black Rings have been successfully removed, new Black Rings keep popping up.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: People keep turning into Sinners under their influence, one after another.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The Black Ring is probably only the result of mass occurrences of a certain phenomenon, and its impact is irreversible.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Now, what do you think is the thing that causes a Black Ring to occur, Chief?
Summer throws the question at you.
You think of the black box brought to the negotiation venue, the thing that turned Zoya into the Black Ring's ground zero.
The thing that lives inside your body now.
An answer slowly forms in your brain, the one you reject the most.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Correct, it's the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'm lucky enough to have seen the residue of that thing. Only a few picograms of it... can generate an infinite amount of energy.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I'm very positive that it's something that absolutely, definitely does not belong in this world.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: If I find it... If I find it, the source of the disaster, the truth of the world will be presented right before my eyes.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: How I wish to see it... I wish to see it so much!

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Don't you want to see it, Chief? To find out what the secret hidden beneath the filthiest soil is?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Oh... Seriously? Don't lie to me, Chief.
I only saw it in a dream, it looked like... a white box.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: And inside it? Is there anything inside the box?
As soon as you mention the white box, Summer seems really intrigued.
There seems to be... a fragment inside.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Hahahaha... I see, I see!
As if having an epiphany, Summer suddenly laughs loudly.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Thanks for telling me that, Chief. But one must not lie.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: If you saw it with your own eyes, then admit it. Don't make up some dream like that.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Otherwise... things may end up terribly for you.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: No wonder... your aura feels so familiar, Chief.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It feels like the lab at Parma...
Summer leans into you, her warm breaths brushing against your ear.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Dear Chief, how do you explain the thing about the Black Ring in Keylan Square? The records show that no one was sent to clean up the site after its disappearance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: It should be the most valuable research material, yet there has been no news about it in the FAC, the Legion, or even the Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The only possible explanation is that... the MBCC has taken it.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Half a month ago, I infiltrated the MBCC's intranet, but I didn't find any information about the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: That's why I'm sure that...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: The inheritance, is inside you, right now.
She points at the tip of your nose with her index finger.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: When I first saw you, I thought you were just an ordinary person, someone who shared my interest in anime.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: ...The shackles and the Black Ring's fragments. These are areas out of reach of ordinary people.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What has been presented before me only lead me to believe that you're the ideal vessel for the truth!
Summer expands her armor and walks toward you slowly.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: What kind of answer can I find on you?

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: When the source of Sinners, the source of Mania, and the source of the Ring all combine into one, what will be the outcome... I'm really looking forward to that.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Will it be coexistence or destruction? Let's go, Chief, explore the truth and mystery of the world with me!
Summer's expression has grown frantic, as if she's completely lost her sanity.
You want to put the Bureau in the emergency mode to temporarily block Summer's ability.
But right after you press the button on the control panel, you find that nothing happens.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: I've already told you, I've infiltrated the intranet half a month ago. Why wouldn't I have the Bureau's admin rights? You've truly underestimated the power of Infinite Knowledge, Chief.
You want to forbid her actions with the shackles, but before you can say more than one word, a tranquilizer shot is stuck in your leg.
You...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let's go! Let's go! Chief...

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Let's begin our experiment!

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: The Chief of the MBCC and S-Class Sinner Summer have gone missing.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Okay.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: The first target is deduced to be the ruins of the Laboratory of Parma.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Yes, this is the outcome I've been anticipating.

steps.speaker: Laplace
steps.content: Welcome back, my genius.
